learn_source: Watch the blacksmith light the forge at the bench in the Town scene, or watch a neighbour burn a dry hedge to clear it in the Forest
confirm_action: Cast it yourself on inert material once — seeing the neighbour's cast gives only the clue
mana_effect: Quality only: a bigger, cleaner, steadier flame at high mana; a small sputtering catch at baseline. Never whether the cast is possible.

unlocks.obstacle: The dry hedge blocking the path
unlocks.witnessable_cast: A neighbour burns a dry hedge to clear it before the player ever tries

receivers.physical_outcome: Catches at the tip and holds a small, steady flame
Catches along its dry inner branches; smoke first, then the flame burns through, clearing the path it had blocked
Takes the heat and glows through, holding it — too hot to lift
State-dependent: unlit and stocked, the banked fuel catches and the furnace lights, draft picking up; already lit, nothing changes
Crust scorches and blackens at the edges; the loaf is ruined; no flame catches
receivers.reaction_kind: third-party objection if Toby is present (canon-gated bystander bark)

receivers.physical_outcome: No physical effect — the spell's light washes over the fur and fades without catching
receivers.reaction_kind: startle-flee to cover, watch from distance, stress-groom
deflection — redirects the act toward his own work (canon-gated, ruled 2026-07-26)
